title: Dragon of the Red Dawn
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to old Japan to find a secret of happiness — and ride a rain-making dragon to save the city of Edo! 🐉🌸

q.en: Who is Basho in this story?

options.en: a famous Japanese poet named Basho
options.zh: 一位名叫芭蕉的日本著名诗人

options.en: an old fisherman who sells fish at the market
options.zh: 一个在集市卖鱼的老渔夫

options.en: the shogun who rules the city of Edo
options.zh: 统治江户城的大将军（将军）

options.en: a young samurai warrior in training
options.zh: 一个正在受训的年轻武士

explain.en: Basho is one of Japan's greatest poets. Jack reads in their research book that Basho wrote short, beautiful poems that still speak to people today.
explain.zh: 芭蕉是日本最伟大的诗人之一。杰克在参考书里读到，芭蕉写的短小优美的诗，到今天仍能让人们产生共鸣。

q.en: About how much did each sumo wrestler weigh?
q.zh: 每个相扑力士大约有多重？

options.en: only about 100 pounds
more than 400 pounds
less than 50 pounds
over 1,000 pounds each

explain.en: When Jack and Annie watched the sumo match, the text says each of the two enormously fat men looked as if he weighed more than four hundred pounds.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮观看相扑比赛时，书里写道，那两个极其肥胖的力士看起来每个人都重达四百多磅。

q.en: What five-word command made the Wand of Dianthus finally work?
q.zh: 是哪句五个字的咒语让狄安萨斯魔杖终于生效了？

options.en: Put out the fire, please
Make rain fall on Edo
Send us home at once
Turn the samurai to stone

explain.en: Annie waved the wand and cried 'Put. Out. The. Fire!' then added 'Please!' — five words. The wand then whisked them to the Cloud Dragon, who rained on the fire.
explain.zh: 安妮挥动魔杖喊道“把。火。扑灭！”然后补上“请！”，正好五个字。魔杖随即将他们送到云龙那里，云龙降下大雨浇灭了大火。

q.en: What is the Cloud Dragon in the legend Basho tells?
q.zh: 芭蕉所讲的传说里，云龙是什么？

options.en: a guardian dragon of the rain clouds
a giant paper puppet from the market show
options.zh: 集市表演里的一只巨大纸偶

options.en: a swift silver fish from the deep Edo river
options.zh: 江户深河里一条敏捷的银鱼

options.en: a small frog that lives by the pond
options.zh: 住在池塘边的一只小青蛙

explain.en: Basho says the Cloud Dragon is one of the guardian animals of the four directions, with the power of flight and the ability to command the rain clouds.
explain.zh: 芭蕉说，云龙是四方守护神兽之一，拥有飞行的力量，还能指挥雨云。

q.en: What was Japan's capital city called in the 1600s?
q.zh: 在 17 世纪（1600 年代），日本的都城叫什么？

options.en: Edo, later renamed Tokyo
Nagasaki, the port city
Kyoto, the old royal city
options.zh: 京都，古老的皇城，发生在很久很久以前

options.en: Osaka, the merchant town

explain.en: Their Japan book says that in the 1600s the capital was called Edo, and in the mid-1800s its name was changed to Tokyo.
explain.zh: 他们的日本参考书说，17 世纪时都城叫江户，到了 19 世纪中叶改名为东京。

options.en: rice balls with raw fish inside
options.zh: 里面包着生鱼米的饭团

options.en: long noodles topped with a sweet red sauce
options.zh: 上面浇着甜红酱的长面条

options.en: chunks of chicken grilled on a stick
options.zh: 串在竹签上烤的鸡肉块

options.en: warm soup with little dumplings

explain.en: Basho tells Jack and Annie that sushi is rice with pieces of raw fish in the middle, wrapped in papery strips of seaweed.
explain.zh: 芭蕉告诉杰克和安妮，寿司是中间夹着生鱼片、外面包着薄薄海苔的米饭。

q.en: Where did Jack and Annie first land when the wand's magic worked?
q.zh: 魔杖的魔法生效时，杰克和安妮最初落在了哪里？

options.en: inside Basho's tiny bamboo hut
on the slope of Mount Fuji
inside the Imperial Palace
on the busy Great Bridge

explain.en: After Annie's command, a blinding light left them standing on a mountain ledge with red dawn light; Annie says 'I think we're on Mount Fuji.'
explain.zh: 安妮念完咒语后，一道刺眼的光芒把他们送到了一处红色晨光中的山崖上；安妮说“我想我们是在富士山上。”

q.en: Which line is from the poem Basho gave to Jack?
q.zh: 下面哪一句是芭蕉送给杰克的诗？

options.en: A dragon breathes fire across the dawn
options.zh: 巨龙在黎明中喷出火焰

options.en: The red sun lights the wide morning sky
options.zh: 红日照亮了辽阔的晨空

options.en: An old pond—a frog jumps in, water sounds
options.zh: 古池——青蛙跳入，水声荡漾

options.en: The brave young samurai rides to the palace
options.zh: 勇敢的年轻武士骑马奔向宫殿

explain.en: Basho read his new poem aloud: 'An old pond: a frog jumps in—the sound of water.' He then gave the paper to Jack.
explain.zh: 芭蕉大声念了他新写的诗：“古池——青蛙跳入，水声荡漾。”然后他把这首诗的纸送给了杰克。

q.en: What secret of happiness did Jack and Annie find for Merlin?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮为梅林找到了什么幸福的秘密？

options.en: collecting official passports from the samurai
options.zh: 从武士那里收集官方通行证

options.en: eating all the sushi that you can
noticing the small beauties of nature
options.zh: 留意大自然中细微的美好

options.en: winning a great sumo wrestling match
options.zh: 赢下一场盛大的相扑比赛

explain.en: Jack realizes the secret is 'paying really close attention to the small things in nature,' just as Basho taught them to find beauty in small moments like a frog splashing.
explain.zh: 杰克明白，这个秘密就是“非常用心地去留意大自然中微小的事物”，就像芭蕉教他们的，从青蛙溅水这样的小瞬间里发现美。

options.en: the red dragon of the rain clouds
the bright morning sunshine
the banana tree in his yard
the old quiet garden pond

explain.en: Basho tells Jack and Annie, 'I like this tree so much I have taken my name from it. Basho means banana tree.'
explain.zh: 芭蕉对杰克和安妮说：“我太喜欢这棵树了，就用它做了我的名字。芭蕉的意思就是香蕉树。”
